name: Necromancer Harvest Plague rank 1 siphon heal includes the per-level base points
contract: Harvest Plague rank 1 (spell 500968) heals the caster each tick for the application's base roll times 0.30 plus the target's missing health fraction, as measured in live combat logs (2026-06..08). The roll is effect 0's DBC base 28 plus 0.833 per level from level 16, capped at 22, plus 1-3 and no spell power: 34-36 at level 80. Without the per-level points the roll is 29-31, which heals 8-9 at full target health and 34-37 at 10%.

steps.label: One siphon heal after the first tick
Siphon on a full-health target heals 0.30 of the level-scaled roll
One siphon heal at 10% target health
Siphon at 10% target health heals 1.20 of the level-scaled roll
